name: android-utilities
description: Android SDK utility tools for texture compression and heap analysis

tools.description: ETC1 texture compression for OpenGL ES performance optimization
tools.usage:
etc1tool texture.png --encode -o compressed.pkm # Compress to ETC1 with header
etc1tool texture.png --encodeNoHeader -o raw.etc1 # Raw ETC1 data without header
etc1tool compressed.pkm --decode -o output.png # Decompress to PNG
etc1tool input.png --encode --showDifference diff.png # Show compression artifacts
etc1tool batch/*.png --encode # Batch compress all PNG files

tools.description: HPROF heap dump converter for Android memory profiling tools
tools.usage: hprof-conv android.hprof standard.hprof # Convert Android to standard HPROF\nhprof-conv -z app.hprof filtered.hprof # Exclude Zygote heap data\nadb shell am dumpheap com.app /sdcard/heap.hprof && adb pull /sdcard/heap.hprof && hprof-conv heap.hprof mat.hprof # Full workflow
